notes.title: Rebalance of Sarionthia faction
notes.content:
The Sarioanthia faction was the last faction whose balance was questionable and who could not stand an equal fight with the other factions. We are introducing an update to the Imperial Faction that will change the faction's strengths and tactics on battlefield.

Full list of changes:
* Fixed bugs related to the effects of some cards
* Rebalance of some common cards
* Rebalance of Sarioanthia faction

notes.title: Version 1.2.4 for Macs
notes.content:
What's new?
1. Fixed the bug with the non-execution of the effects of spy cards with the “last wish” attribute.
2. Fixed the bug when the game considers that the player did not play a card, although in reality he played it.

notes.title: The Art of War: Card Game - Mobiles and out of Early Access
notes.content:
On February 1st this year this year, The Art of War: Card Game launched in early access on Steam, where everyone could take part in beta testing of the game. And now, after less than three months of testing, bug fixing and balancing, the game is approaching its final stage of development. It will take a little more time for the final balancing of the game, but nevertheless the game is ready for a full-scale launch on all supported gaming platforms:

1.	Steam – Windows, Linux, macOs - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906570
2.	Epic Marketplace – Windows - https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-art-of-war-card-game-e3700e 
3.	Itch.io – Windows - https://brightdawn.itch.io/the-art-of-war-card-game 
4.	AppStore – iOs, iPadOs - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-art-of-war-card-game/id6446330030
5.	Google – Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brightdawn.artofwar

It will take some time to adjust the gameplay balance between factions, but we are not going to sit idly by. We plan to order a test batch of the tabletop version with the lastest edits and prepare a crowdfunding page before the launch. If you haven't subscribed to the desktop version of the game on Gamefound yet, we invite you to do so right now! Don't miss your chance to play The Art of War: Card Game with up to 4 your friends. Link to the project on Gamefound is available below:

https://gamefound.com/projects/brightdawn/the-art-of-war-card-game

As for the further development of the digital version of the game, we have a lot of things that we would like to implement and add to the game. So stay tuned for more news and updates about The Art of War: Card Game.

And finally, welcome to our discord server https://discord.gg/Yz6hzv5VVc, and also if you hasn't seen our gameplay trailer yet you can take a look on it below)
